parent_objective: implement a bounded source-only four-wheel fault dynamics pilot
blocked_by: M1265 admits a source-only four-wheel/fault dynamics pilot
supersedes: another current single-track proxy-fault source repair

public_gates: M1266 must preserve actor input contract
M1266 must not use private holdout
M1266 must not integrate new privileged observations into actor inputs
M1266 must not claim high-fidelity simulator or real-vehicle validity
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add per-wheel or fault labels to actor inputs
do not replace the main Gym env without a separate design
do not claim source-positive rows from model-unit tests

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: implements and tests source-only four-wheel fault dynamics primitives needed for later source mining
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: infrastructure/model primitive only; no training, promotion, private-holdout, paper-level, source-positive, recurrent-belief, or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if model outputs non-finite states or forces under bounded faults
stop if asymmetric faults cannot produce signed yaw-moment differences
stop if implementation requires actor input expansion
fallback_plan: if in-repo four-wheel pilot is unstable, write model-limit audit and consider external-engine scout
if tests pass, next milestone can design source-collector integration
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1265 admits source-only four-wheel fault dynamics pilot

admission_evidence: M1265 identifies left-right/per-wheel force asymmetry as the next source-fidelity variable
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: split-mu and brake-pull signed yaw-moment tests pass
single-wheel grip collapse force-capacity test passes

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1266 implements source dynamics primitives and does not test actor history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: future actor history tests remain blocked until source-positive cases exist
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If model primitives cannot express signed asymmetric-fault response, record model-limit evidence and do not force source mining.
allowed_claims: source-only four-wheel fault dynamics primitive test result
no source-positive, recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: A compact source-only four-wheel model can express finite signed yaw-moment differences under left-right/per-wheel faults, enabling a later source-collector integration branch.
success_criteria: left-right split-mu signed yaw-moment test passes
single-wheel brake-pull signed yaw-moment test passes
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: bounded faults produce non-finite state or force outputs
asymmetric faults cannot produce signed yaw-moment differences
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, or threshold relaxation occurs

commands.name: focused_tests
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q tests/test_four_wheel_dynamics.py

decision_rule: M1266 passes as infrastructure if the four-wheel fault primitives are finite, deterministic, and express signed asymmetric-fault yaw response without changing actor inputs.
